classification.difficultyReason: Choose appropriate rules for independent length, area-inverse, angle and perimeter tasks.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the length of $AB$ to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Source-shaped triangle with C at left, A upper right and B lower right. Black sides and labels; interior black angle arc at C. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: CA=6 cm; CB=9 cm; angle ACB=30 degrees; AB unlabelled.

children.label: d
children.prompt: The area of the triangle is $9.23\text{ cm}^2$. Find the size of $\angle ACB$ to the nearest degree.

spec.description: Black source-shaped triangle with C at left, A upper right and B lower right. No angle arc or angle value. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: CA=6 cm; CB=9 cm; AB unlabelled; C is drawn acute.

answer.worked:
Using the acute angle shown:
$$\begin{align*}9.23&=\tfrac12(6)(9)\sin C\\\sin C&=\frac{9.23}{27}\\C&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{9.23}{27}\right)\\\angle ACB&\approx20^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: Find the size of angle $\angle BAC$ to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Black triangle with C at left, A upper right, B lower right and an interior arc at B. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: CA=9 cm; AB=8 cm; angle ABC=50 degrees; CB unlabelled.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin C}{8}&=\frac{\sin50^\circ}{9}\\\sin C&=\frac{8\sin50^\circ}{9}\\C&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{8\sin50^\circ}{9}\right)\\\angle BAC&=180^\circ-50^\circ-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{8\sin50^\circ}{9}\right)\\\angle BAC&\approx87.1^\circ\end{align*}$$
The supplementary value of $C$ would make $B+C>180^\circ$.
